info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Rooms Amenities-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Amenities API provides users with access to a comprehensive list of amenities available in hotel rooms. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about various amenities that can enhance a guest's stay, such as Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and breakfast options. This functionality is essential for travel applications, booking platforms, or hospitality management systems where users need to compare and select hotels based on available amenities. By integrating this API, business partners can improve customer satisfaction and streamline booking processes.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of amenities available in rooms.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all amenities associated with the available rooms. Useful for understanding what each room offers and helping users make an informed choice.
